nodes.name: BottomPanelContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the tab-content switcher for the CodeEditor bottom panel, keeping Problems/Output/Test Results tabs mounted (display:none) simultaneously to preserve their state across tab switches.

nodes.name: BottomPanelHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the bottom panel's header with tabs and tab-specific controls, swapping chrome between bottom-pill and right-tabbar layouts via the shared PanelTabBar depending on panel position.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports bottom panel tab constants from the workstation store and defines the icon-name mapping used for each bottom panel tab.

nodes.name: OutputSearchPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Search toolbar overlay for the Output tab, rendering a match-count indicator, previous/next navigation buttons, and Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape keyboard shortcuts for driving text search in the output log.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Output tab body (log lines for the active output channel) with a toggleable in-panel search overlay wired to the useOutputSearch hook.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for output channels, log lines, and per-channel panel configuration used by the Output tab.

nodes.name: useOutputSearch.ts
nodes.summary: Hook implementing in-DOM text search and highlighting for the Output log: builds a search regex, walks text nodes, wraps matches in <mark> elements, and exposes next/previous navigation plus highlight-clearing controls.

nodes.name: HealthStatusDisplay.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays the workspace lint/health scan status (idle/scanning/error/ok) with a matching icon and label inside the Problems tab.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Problems tab's diagnostics tree grouped by file, with collapsible file groups, severity icons, click-to-navigate rows, and the workspace health status indicator.

nodes.name: problemsUtils.tsx
nodes.summary: Pure helper functions for the Problems tab: groups diagnostics by file, resolves severity icons, formats location suffixes, and flattens the grouped diagnostics tree into a renderable row list.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for diagnostic problems (severity, location, message), per-file diagnostic groups, and aggregate diagnostic summaries used across the Problems tab.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Test Results tab body, listing test run results with status icons and click-to-navigate-to-source behavior.

nodes.name: useBottomPanelActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook building the shared quick-action buttons (clear channel, toggle-expand-all, clear diagnostics, scan workspace) surfaced in the bottom panel header, dispatched through the unified ActionSystem with i18n labels.

nodes.name: useBottomPanelTabs.ts
nodes.summary: Hook managing bottom-panel active-tab switching via ActionSystem dispatch, invoking an onTabChange callback when the tab changes.

nodes.name: useProblemsState.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that merges workspace-scan and LSP diagnostics, deduplicates them, groups them by file, and manages per-file collapse/expand state for the Problems tab.

nodes.name: useWorkspaceScan.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that starts or aborts a full workspace lint scan and opens the results in a dedicated editor tab.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator component for the CodeEditor's bottom panel (Problems/Output/Terminal/Test Results tabs); wires together the header, content switcher, and per-tab config hooks, dispatching all panel and terminal actions through the unified ActionSystem.

nodes.name: OutputTab.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that assembles the Output tab's TabConfig (icon, title, actions, content) from output channels and active-channel state for consumption by the bottom panel.

nodes.name: ProblemsTab.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that assembles the Problems tab's TabConfig, including a small diagnostics count badge and filtered actions based on scanning/diagnostics state.

nodes.name: TerminalTab.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook (plus an inline rename-input subcomponent) that assembles the standalone Terminal tab's TabConfig: session list, in-place rename, resizable sidebar, and terminal action dispatching.

nodes.name: TestResultsTab.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that assembles the Test Results tab's TabConfig for the bottom panel.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared prop and tab-configuration type definitions (EditorBottomPanelProps, TabAction, TabConfig) used by the bottom panel and its tab hooks.

nodes.name: CodeEditorDefaultHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Default header for the code editor pane showing the repo/file name plus quick toggles (line numbers, minimap, word wrap, highlight active line) and a reveal-in-Finder action.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Configuration for the editor main pane: default panel state, tab-type icon/title config, and factories building the editor and source-control quick-action lists surfaced in the command palette.

nodes.name: autoSaveScheduler.ts
nodes.summary: Pure scheduling helpers that decide whether an auto-save should run and debounce/schedule the actual save timer for the code viewer.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the useCodeViewerHandlers hook and its return type from the CodeViewerContent hooks folder.

nodes.name: useCodeViewerHandlers.ts
nodes.summary: Large hook orchestrating the code viewer's editing lifecycle: cursor/selection tracking, dirty-state and auto-save scheduling, preview-mode detection (markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV), conflict-marker detection, save/reload/discard handlers with unsaved-changes confirmation, selection-based agent-chat actions, and global save/reload keyboard shortcuts.

nodes.name: buildSearchRegex
nodes.summary: Escapes and compiles the user's search query into a case-insensitive/whole-word RegExp used to scan output text.

nodes.name: getTextNodes
nodes.summary: Walks a DOM container with a TreeWalker to collect all text nodes eligible for search highlighting.

nodes.name: useOutputSearch
nodes.summary: Hook implementing search-state management, match highlighting via DOM <mark> wrapping, and next/previous match navigation for the Output tab's search panel.

nodes.name: getStatusIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a workspace health/scan status value to its corresponding icon and color.

nodes.name: groupDiagnosticsByFile
nodes.summary: Groups a flat diagnostics list by file path, computing per-file error/warning counts and sorting groups by file name.

nodes.name: getSeverityIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a diagnostic severity level to its display icon and color.

nodes.name: formatDiagnosticLocationSuffix
nodes.summary: Formats a diagnostic's line/column into a human-readable location suffix string.

nodes.name: flattenProblemsTree
nodes.summary: Flattens grouped diagnostics into a single renderable row list, honoring per-file collapsed/expanded state.

nodes.name: useBottomPanelActions
nodes.summary: Builds the bottom panel's shared header actions (clear channel, expand/collapse all, clear diagnostics, scan workspace), dispatched through the unified ActionSystem with translated labels.

nodes.name: useBottomPanelTabs
nodes.summary: Handles bottom-panel active-tab switching via ActionSystem dispatch and invokes an onTabChange callback.

nodes.name: useProblemsState
nodes.summary: Merges and deduplicates scan/LSP diagnostics, groups them by file, and manages collapsed-file-group state for the Problems tab.

nodes.name: useWorkspaceScan
nodes.summary: Starts or aborts a full workspace lint scan and opens a dedicated results tab.

nodes.name: useOutputTabConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the TabConfig (title, icon, actions, content) for the bottom panel's Output tab.

nodes.name: useProblemsTabConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the TabConfig for the Problems tab, including a count badge and scanning-aware action filtering.

nodes.name: InlineRenameInput
nodes.summary: Inline text input for renaming a terminal session, committing on Enter/blur and canceling on Escape.

nodes.name: useTerminalTabConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the standalone Terminal tab's TabConfig: session list rendering, inline rename, resizable sidebar, and terminal lifecycle action dispatching.

nodes.name: useTestResultsTabConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the TabConfig for the bottom panel's Test Results tab.

nodes.name: CodeEditorDefaultHeader
nodes.summary: Default editor-pane header component showing the active file/repo name plus toggles for line numbers, minimap, word wrap, and active-line highlight, and a reveal-in-Finder action.

nodes.name: createEditorQuickActions
nodes.summary: Builds the command-palette quick-action entries for opening workspace/editor spotlight search.

nodes.name: createSourceControlQuickActions
nodes.summary: Builds command-palette quick-action entries for navigating to source-control views (branches, changes, history), filtered by availability.

nodes.name: shouldScheduleAutoSave
nodes.summary: Pure predicate deciding whether an auto-save attempt should be scheduled based on edit-version and dirty state.

nodes.name: scheduleAutoSaveTimer
nodes.summary: Sets a debounced timer that triggers a save if the edit version hasn't changed since scheduling.

nodes.name: useCodeViewerHandlers
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the code viewer's save/reload/discard lifecycle, auto-save scheduling, preview-mode detection, conflict-marker detection, selection-based agent-chat actions, and global keyboard shortcuts.
